reading: The sketch, fully specified by typed notes, lays out a week-view calendar app: a left sidebar (Create button, mini month calendar, calendars list), a top day-of-week header row, a left hour-label column, a striped time grid, seven coloured event blocks placed on it, a red current-time line, and a detail popover panel for the "Sprint planning" event with a Join call button.
